title: eval-context
description: What an evaluation result was produced from, so that two results can be compared: the skill content, the fixtures that were run, the grader rules and the runner. Produced by `aicore.content.eval.eval_context`; only observed values are recorded, anything not observed is null or an empty list.

skill.description: The evaluated skill, or null when the result is not about one skill (the system bank).

fixtures.description: The evaluation inputs that were run.

grader.description: The rules that graded the runs.

skill.description: Identity and content of the evaluated skill.

id.description: Identity of the skill: `<bucket>/<name>`, the id of its skill descriptor.

digest.description: Tagged SHA-256 of the skill content (`aicore.content.skill.skill_digest`), so a changed skill is a different subject.

id.description: Kind of the fixtures: `evals` for the evals.json and pressure.json of a skill, `system-bank` for the system bank.

version.description: Declared version of the fixtures (the bank version), or null when they carry none.

digest.description: Tagged SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the fixtures (`aicore.util.digest.digest_json`).

version.description: Version of the grading rules; changes whenever the grading of an assertion changes. Null when the grader declares none.

runner.description: The program that executed the runs.

provider.description: Provider of the runner, such as `claude-code`.

cli_version.description: Version printed by `<cli> --version`, or null when it was not observed.

models.description: Sorted names of the models the runs reported using (`modelUsage`); an empty list when none was observed.
